verdict.rationale: n8n has a dedicated first-party docs page titled "n8n API" (docs.n8n.io/connect/n8n-api), and the Webhook node documentation shows workflows can be triggered over HTTP, so a documented public API exists. The evidence is only a page title, though, with nothing on the API's scope, authentication or endpoints, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at the standard docs paths. That missing spec matters for AI-native clients that consume specs automatically. missing for 10: API scope/endpoint and auth details, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving n8n via the API
